0f33cbad999b81f446858b93d6343deccd1d481a.summary: Yoroi Malware ZLab describes attackers' growing use of XLL files, Excel add-in binaries that Microsoft Excel loads in one click, as an emerging Office delivery method seen from mid-2021. The XLL dropper it analyses used Excel-DNA and process hollowing, and fetched AgentTesla, Formbook and Dridex payloads from Discord CDN. The report observed campaigns against manufacturing companies in Italy and frames the trend as a warning of possible new malicious email waves in 2022.
